subject.title: fix(text): strip MiniMax marker from channel replies

question: Should this PR require current-head live proof from official `minimax` or `minimax-portal`, or should maintainers explicitly override that proof gate based on the source-level tests?
rationale: The implementation follows the requested architecture, but only a maintainer can accept the remaining uncertainty from not observing the changed wrapper against the official provider’s real event stream.

options.title: Require official-provider proof
options.body: Capture a redacted official MiniMax or MiniMax Portal reply showing the suffix removed, plus a literal-marker continuation or tool-use case showing ordinary text remains intact.

options.title: Override the proof gate
options.body: Accept the regression suite and provider-boundary analysis as sufficient despite the absence of a current-head official-provider run.

options.title: Pause until proof is available
options.body: Leave the PR open without merge until suitable official-provider credentials or a maintainer-run live environment can produce the evidence.

recommendation.title: Require official-provider proof
recommendation.body: Capture a redacted official MiniMax or MiniMax Portal reply showing the suffix removed, plus a literal-marker continuation or tool-use case showing ordinary text remains intact.

likelyOwner.reason: They made the ownership-layer decision, stopped automerge, and placed the PR into human review after inspecting live provider differences.
